findings.evidence: Frozen main trace omits regionalCrisis.id. The accepted stress arc uses uninterrupted monotonic canonical phases; contribution.major event 66 and resolution event 75 are visible, but exact same-ID and saved life ledger are not directly exposed in the frozen run trace.
findings.impact: The formal complete arc is accepted with inferred identity; standalone strict-ID/life-ledger recorder requires its own completed runtime evidence.

findings.evidence: The agent run records phase/outcome and 19 crisis-phase policy-choice rows (2 initiation choices plus 17 combat turns), but no aftermath save/reload. The validator’s count is not a count of persisted contributions. The paired basic J arc gate is met by the stress run.
findings.impact: Agent lane does not independently prove aftermath reload or contribution-ledger state.

findings.evidence: Stress final checkpoint at ~1201s has 4598 DOM nodes / 922 JS listeners versus 2140 / 442 at the preceding ~1151s checkpoint; openDialogs=0. The single terminal sample has no following checkpoint. Agent final sample returns to 2148 / 441. Heap spikes in both lanes oscillate and repeatedly drop near 6–7 MB; journalPending remains 0 and save/reload latency stays within observed ranges.
findings.impact: No persistent §78 symptom is demonstrated; do not infer a leak or automatically require 60–120m. Keep the stress terminal sample unresolved; targeted follow-up can distinguish transient context retention from persistent detached DOM.

findings.evidence: Supplemental run 20261008T035215Z-pid60577 retains raw FAILED because its strict parsed-save comparator detected lastSavedAt changing 1791431561867→1791431561991. Independent offline semantic comparison verified all other parsed save fields identical, including worldTime, RNG, seed, exact regionalCrisis/contribution ledger, event sequence, and history.
findings.impact: Classify lifecycle/reload as PASS WITH LIMITATIONS while preserving raw FAILED as a writer-metadata false negative; this is not world drift.

findings.evidence: Supplemental run ledger remained empty before/after; eligible player-owned unequipped gear count was zero; recorded actions were legal waits through the crisis phases.
findings.impact: LifeContribution is NOT EXERCISED for this local scenario. Existing I 500-pair evidence and the normal stress camp arc remain separate evidence; NPC resolution is not player contribution.

stress.observation: heap oscillates and repeatedly returns near 6–7 MB; terminal DOM/listener spike is one sample with no post-terminal sample to establish persistence

agent.observation: heap oscillates with repeated returns near 6–7 MB; DOM/listeners return near baseline

performance.extensionRecommendation: No automatic 60–120 minute extension under spec §78: no demonstrated persistent heap rise, monotonic DOM/listener growth, journal backlog, save latency degradation, duplicate crisis, or reload drift. Preserve the stress terminal DOM/listener sample as an unresolved anomaly; a targeted post-reload checkpoint is appropriate if available. A single final sample with openDialogs=0 cannot distinguish transient retained browser context from persistent detached DOM.

lifeContribution.interpretation: Actions were visible legal day waits through warning/preparation and active; no feasible UI food/gold support or eligible player gear was evidenced. NPC automatic resolution is not player LifeContribution.

supplementalNormalArc.assessment: Lifecycle/reload PASS WITH LIMITATIONS; LifeContribution NOT EXERCISED; this does not upgrade the raw FAILED status or make the whole product finding a pass.

verification.result: PASS; reviewer ran offline validator only and did not start a browser.

supplemental.method: Offline decompression and semantic comparison of full-save-policy-trace before/after reload; cross-checked run-status.json, aftermath-save-reload.jsonl, actions.jsonl, and full-save-policy-trace.jsonl.
supplemental.result: Only lastSavedAt differs; all other full-save fields equal. No browser retry or raw artifact edits.

disposition: Accept J engineering QA evidence with findings; this does not authorize product/human acceptance or release beyond the ticket gates.
